eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Humboldt, CA; at 3:04 PM on AUG 30, 2021 Effective until 4:04 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: THIS IS A HUMBOLDT ALERT- An EVACUATION ORDER has been issued for all areas west of Forest Route 6N33 to the end of Fourmile Creek, south of Christian School Road to Friday Ridge Road. Leave now for your safety. PLEASE DO NOT CONTACT 911 UNLESS OF AN EMERGENCY OR IMMINENT DANGER TO LIFE. For more information call 707-268-2500.
